name: 高驰训练
description: Review COROS training and health data, and update plans or workouts after you confirm.
description_zh: 连接高驰账号，查询运动、睡眠、恢复与体能数据，并在你确认后创建、修改训练计划、课程库模板和每日排期。
description_en: Review COROS health and training, then create or update plans and workouts after confirmation.
examples_zh: 看看我最近两周的跑步记录
分析我这个月的睡眠和恢复情况
结合最近的训练，帮我做一份六周半马计划
把这周四的阈值间歇缩短到 20 分钟
明天安排一节 30 分钟轻松跑
看看我这个月练得是不是太多了
examples_en: Show my runs from the past two weeks
How did my sleep and recovery look this month?
Build a six-week half-marathon plan from my recent training
Shorten this Thursday's threshold session to 20 minutes
Schedule a 30-minute easy run for tomorrow
